# SaltWatch Card 0.6.3

This release keeps the divider between paired salt-level and forecast metrics centered when forecast progress or another explanation is displayed, and incorporates reviewed Danish low-marker terminology.

## What changed

- Separated forecast explanations from the primary paired-metric row so their height no longer pulls the divider out of alignment.
- Scoped the alternate layout to paired metrics with an explanation; numeric forecasts and forecast-only cards retain their existing structure.
- Preserved the horizontal stacked layout and the compact side-by-side layout used by narrow or short cards.
- Changed the Danish low-marker label from `Lavgrænse` to `Minimumsmærke` throughout the card, accessibility description, and graphical-editor controls.
- Kept threshold terminology unchanged where the text describes the numeric boundary rather than the visual marker.

## Compatibility

- No configuration changes are required.
- Forecast values, status handling, actions, tank rendering, and low-marker behavior are unchanged.
- The release supports both SaltWatch device discovery and manually mapped water-softener entities.

## Validation

- 56 unit tests passed.
- 47 browser tests passed across desktop and mobile Chromium; one desktop-only mobile-scroll test was skipped as intended.
- Browser coverage includes every built-in unavailable-forecast explanation, English, German, Danish, long custom detail text, natural and fixed heights, stacked metrics, and compact side-by-side metrics.
- The longer Danish `Minimumsmærke` label was verified in narrow fixed-height cards without clipping or overflow.
- The production TypeScript and Vite build passed.
